# Unit test for function closest_integer
def test_closest_integer():
    # Whole numbers
    assert closest_integer("10") == 10
    assert closest_integer("-10") == -10
    assert closest_integer("0") == 0

    # Values below and above the halfway point
    assert closest_integer("2.4") == 2
    assert closest_integer("2.6") == 3
    assert closest_integer("-2.4") == -2
    assert closest_integer("-2.6") == -3

    # Exact halves round away from zero
    assert closest_integer("2.5") == 3
    assert closest_integer("-2.5") == -3
    assert closest_integer("0.5") == 1
    assert closest_integer("-0.5") == -1

    # Trailing zeros should not affect rounding
    assert closest_integer("3.5000") == 4
    assert closest_integer("-3.5000") == -4
    assert closest_integer("4.000") == 4
